name: Remove Redundant tl.where Guards from Masked Accumulators
matchText: Remove Redundant tl.where Guards from Masked Accumulators: A loop-carried accumulator is updated with a full-width tl.where select on every iteration, for example acc = tl.where(mask, acc + delta, acc) seeded by tl.full(..., 0, tl.float32), while every load feeding the accumulated expression uses other=0.0 so masked-out lanes already contribute zero and the select only re-selects values that are already present.
content:
Problem:
A masked cross-iteration accumulator pays one full-width vector select per loop
iteration plus a serial read-add-select-write dependency chain, and keeps a
zero-initialized wide value alive across the whole loop, even though the guard
changes nothing.

Safety argument:
The select is redundant when the accumulated expression is provably zero on
masked lanes: every load feeding it uses other=0.0 (or is multiplied by such a
value), so the summand delta is exactly 0.0 wherever the mask is false and the
plain add already preserves the accumulator there.

Recommended changes:
- Trace each operand of the accumulated expression and confirm masked lanes are
  zero (other=0.0 on every contributing load, or a zero constant factor).
- Remove the tl.where and accumulate with a plain add.
- When a companion transformation (pass merge) removes the loop entirely, drop
  the accumulator machinery with it: no tl.full zero initialization, no add
  chain, just a single tl.sum over the freshly computed expression.
- Keep masks on loads and stores untouched; only the accumulator guard changes.

Constraints:
- Keep the tl.where when any contributing load lacks other=0.0 or when the
  summand may be non-zero on masked lanes, for example a value loaded without
  a mask or reused from an earlier unmasked computation.
- Keep the accumulator itself when the loop still runs multiple iterations;
  only the per-iteration select is redundant.
- Preserve the accumulation dtype and the reduction axis of the final tl.sum.
sourceReference: KernelAgent-ascend@8865132:npu_test/optimize_02_MLP/input.py (tl.where accumulator identified as a runtime hotspot in static-diagnosis experiments)
